help.pageSubtitle: Learn how to use MeritCyc's admin features to manage merit cycles, evaluations, and payroll decisions.
help.notFound: Can't find what you're looking for? Contact your system administrator or support team.

cycles.title: Manage Increment Cycles
cycles.description: Create and manage merit increment cycles with budgets and evaluation criteria.
steps: Navigate to "Cycles" in the main menu
Fill in basic cycle information (name, fiscal year, dates)
Configure evaluation criteria and scoring templates
Managers can now evaluate employees within this cycle

evaluations.title: Manage Evaluations & Scoring
evaluations.description: Review and finalize manager evaluations with score overrides and audit trails.
steps: Use the "Override Score" panel to adjust scores with justification if needed
Add audit notes explaining any changes
Once complete, click "Finalize Cycle" to lock evaluations

budget.title: Budget Simulation & Planning
budget.description: Run what-if scenarios to model budget impact before finalizing increments.
steps: Open a cycle and navigate to "Simulate Budget"
Adjust sliders to model different scenarios:
- Score threshold (minimum score to receive increment)
View real-time impact on employee distribution and total spend
Apply approved scenario to the cycle

people.title: Manage People & Organization
people.description: Maintain employee records, departments, salary bands, and role assignments.
steps: - Employee Directory: View all employees, add new hires
- Salary Bands: Define pay grades and ranges
- Invites: Send registration links to new admins/managers
- Overview tab: Basic info and current role
- Increment History: Past cycles and outcomes
Use filters to find specific employees or groups
Export employee data for external systems

analytics.title: Analytics & Fairness Reports
analytics.description: Analyze pay equity, distribution trends, and department performance.
steps: - Executive Dashboard: High-level metrics and trends
- Year-over-Year Comparison: Trend analysis across cycles
Use "Audit Trail" to track all system changes
Filter by date, action type, and user for compliance

settings.title: Configure Settings
settings.description: Manage company settings, registration, notifications, and security.
steps: - General: Company name, timezone, business rules
- Notifications: Email templates and notification rules
- Data Privacy: Data retention and export settings
Generate data export (ZIP) for backup or compliance
Configure custom business rules for your organization

approvals.title: Approve New Registrations
approvals.description: Review and approve pending employee and manager registrations.
steps: Go to "HR Approvals" to see pending registrations
- Or "Request Info" to ask for more details
Bulk actions: Select multiple to approve/reject at once

tips.planAhead: Plan ahead: Create cycles with sufficient lead time for managers to complete evaluations.
tips.useSimulations: Use simulations: Always run budget scenarios before finalizing to understand financial impact.
tips.reviewFairness: Review fairness: Check pay equity reports before payroll to ensure compliance.
tips.trackAuditTrail: Track audit trail: Use audit logs for compliance and to understand historical decisions.
tips.communicateClearly: Communicate clearly: Ensure managers understand evaluation criteria before the cycle starts.
